rows.grounds: compound referring to a twelfth portion; first member dvādaśa (twelve), second aṃśa (part)
sandhi fusion of vihīne and atha; vihīne indicates absence or exclusion, atha marks transition
locative form indicating the central area
compound describing division into sixteen parts; ṣoḍaśadhā (sixteenfold) + kṛta (made)

items.question: How is the central area to be subdivided after exclusion of a twelfth portion?
premises: A twelfth portion is excluded from consideration.
The subdivision applies to the middle area.
The middle area is made sixteenfold.
items.inference: After excluding a twelfth portion, the central area is divided into sixteen parts.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the excluded twelfth portion depends on the preceding measurement context.
items.plain_english: Then, with a twelfth part excluded, the middle is divided into sixteen parts.
